rules.title: Product leverage ≤ 3
rules.reason: Council lock: optimize worst-month at lev≤3; stretch lev is research-only.

rules.title: No session/5m ORB in product
rules.reason: Costs > edge on 1h/5m ORB; FrequencyORB killed.

rules.title: Read mistake ledger before every fire
rules.reason: Same ticker / same red-day pattern must not auto-repeat.

rules.title: Agents may only reduce risk
rules.reason: Cross-market / breadth / similarity never amplify size.

rules.title: 1-session ticker cooldown after a trade
rules.reason: v5_freq: cutting immediate re-fires reduced Oct bleed without killing 2025 (+99.5% vs v2 +103%).

rules.title: Sit one day after 3 meaningful reds
rules.reason: v5_freq: loss_streak_sitout=3 improved several v2 crash months (e.g. 2021 Oct −20.8% → −4.3%).

rules.title: Cap ~16 trades/month
rules.reason: v5_freq: month cap cuts churn in noisy months; keeps top_k=1 concentration edge.

rules.title: October soft size ×0.5
rules.reason: v2 multi-year: October is the worst calendar cluster (−28.9% 2024, −21.5% 2020, −20.8% 2021, −17.4% 2023). Soft size only — do not sit out (sit-out costs green Oct days).

rules.title: v2.3 asymmetric attack/defense
rules.reason: Keep freq defenses only when underwater or market defense; when YTD green / prior month green, lift trade caps and fire full size to raise year-end. Oct soft only if underwater.

rules.title: Learn failure contexts, not calendar months
rules.reason: Forward path: fingerprint regime/breadth/underwater/streak after meaningful reds; require repeated evidence before size-down/sit. No July/October hardcodes as alpha.
